content: Customers can track their order by logging into their NexaConnect account and going to 'My Orders'. A tracking link is also emailed once the order ships.
Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days. Delivery times may be longer during peak periods (holidays, sales events).
NexaConnect accepts debit/credit cards, bank transfer, and mobile money. If a payment fails, the customer should confirm their card details or try an alternative payment method.
Items can be returned within 7 days of delivery, provided they are unused and in original packaging. Returns are started from 'My Orders' > 'Request Return'.
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected. Customers are notified by email once the refund is issued.
Full product details, including size, material, and stock availability, are listed on each product page under the 'Details' tab.
